metadata.title: AI Research and Engineering | Experience | Theodore Ouyang
metadata.description: Launched in September 2023 for a flagship multimodal foundation model program, this initiative established the project’s statistical governance and resource-allocation framework for reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) across more than 300 domain specialists in travel, food delivery, consumer goods, and e-commerce advertising *(partner corporate identity anonymized under NDA; role, scope, and mathematical design disclosed)*. Rather than executing routine vendor quality assurance, I architected the pilot’s mathematical and operational framework for governing external expert networks, calibrating evolving acceptance standards, and allocating review capacity at scale. By uniting hierarchical Beta-Binomial reliability modeling, prediction-assisted active statistical inference (inverse-probability-weighted residual correction), and capacity-constrained mixed-integer programming, the framework strictly separates *epistemic measurement value* from *defect remediation value*. In a 10,000-submission synthetic benchmark verified across 200,000 independent sampling repetitions with ideal residual calibration, this allocation architecture reduced population quality estimation variance by **17.79%** versus uniform sampling at equal expected audit cost. A separate 200-item analytical example reduced post-review expected error loss by **8.89%** at equal review volume.

metadata.title: Legal Research and Policy Analysis | Experience | Theodore Ouyang
metadata.description: Developed a legal framework for authorizing autonomous space operations when delayed human intervention creates risks of its own. Formulated a two-threshold test separating the authority to act from the evidence needed to delegate execution. Applied it to delayed spacecraft operations, orbital avoidance, debris capture, and SETI, then proposed task-specific authorization records. The resulting framework identifies which decisions can be authorized in advance, which require renewed review, and what evidence must support each choice.
